fullPassage: Instead of asking how much exercise is needed to protect against depression, we should actually be asking how little. The short answer is that just one hour of brisk walking per week has been proven to give some level of protection. If you look into the research, what’s striking is that, in children as well as adults, those who have the most to gain are those who go from doing nothing to doing something — for example, starting to cycle to work or walk to school. But more than that is of course even better, and so one might wonder what level is needed for maximal effects. A number of major, well-conducted studies suggest that between two and six hours of cardiovascular exercise per week is optimal. This is a wide range, but most studies lie closer to two hours than six. More than six hours of exercise per week appears to offer no additional protection.

det.analysis: what's 뒤에 형용사 보어 필요. strike(동사: 치다) → striking(형용사: 놀라운).

questions.passage: Instead of asking how much exercise is needed to protect against depression, we should actually be asking how little. The short answer is that just one hour of brisk walking per week has been proven to give some level of protection. If you look into the research, what’s striking is that, in children as well as adults, those who have the most to gain are those who go from doing nothing to doing something — for example, starting to __________. But more than that is of course even better, and so one might wonder what level is needed for maximal effects. A number of major, well-conducted studies suggest that between two and six hours of cardiovascular exercise per week is optimal. This is a wide range, but most studies lie closer to two hours than six. More than six hours of exercise per week appears to offer no additional protection.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: cycle to work or walk to school: 아무것도 안 하다가 통근/통학 시 운동을 시작하는 예시.
det.analysis:
✅ ① cycle to work or walk to school: 'doing nothing to doing something'의 구체적 예시로 자전거 통근/도보 통학.
❌ ② offer no additional protection: 6시간 이상 운동의 결과이지 'doing something'의 예시가 아님.
❌ ③ ask how much exercise is needed: 첫 문장에서 이미 부정된 질문.
❌ ④ suggest that walking is optimal: 연구 결과 설명이지 개인 행동 예시가 아님.
det.tip: for example ~ 뒤에 구체적 예시가 옴

questions.passage: Instead of asking how much exercise is needed to protect against depression, we should actually be asking __________. The short answer is that just one hour of brisk walking per week has been proven to give some level of protection. If you look into the research, what’s striking is that, in children as well as adults, those who have the most to gain are those who go from doing nothing to doing something — for example, starting to cycle to work or walk to school. But more than that is of course even better, and so one might wonder what level is needed for maximal effects. A number of major, well-conducted studies suggest that between two and six hours of cardiovascular exercise per week is optimal. This is a wide range, but most studies lie closer to two hours than six. More than six hours of exercise per week appears to offer no additional protection.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: how little (얼마나 적게): 얼마나 많이가 아니라 얼마나 '적게' 해도 되는지를 물어야 한다.
det.analysis:
✅ ② how little: 첫 문장의 대비 구조 'how much ~ how little'. 최소 운동량이 주제.
❌ ① how much: '얼마나 많이'는 앞 절에서 이미 사용됨. instead of로 대비.
❌ ③ how often: '얼마나 자주'는 본문 주제와 다름.
❌ ④ how long: '얼마나 오래'는 빈칸 맥락과 다름.
det.tip: instead of A, B = A가 아니라 B
